item.title: Andhra family of 5 found dead in suicide pact at Srisailam pilgrim lodge
item.summary: A heartbreaking event unfolded at the Vaddera Choultries in Srisailam, where five family members allegedly ended their lives. Three women were found lifeless in a bathroom, and two others were discovered hanging. They had been residing in the pilgrim accommodation for nearly a month. Staff members alerted the authorities upon noticing a disturbing smell from the room. Early indications suggest that significant financial difficulties may have driven this desperate decision.
